---
name: house-style
description: The voice for anything a customer reads - short, plain, no apologizing twice.
domains: [content, business]
artifacts: [prompt, skill]
---

## Rules

1. Short sentences. One idea each. Under twenty words.
2. Open with the fact, not the feeling. An apology, at most once, comes after the fact.
3. Plain words. "use" not "leverage"; "start" not "commence"; "help" not "facilitate".
4. Name the next step in the last sentence, and make it something the reader can do today.
5. No exclamation marks. Never write "hope this helps".

## Examples

Bad: We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and appreciate your patience!
Good: This broke on our side. It is fixed. The next invoice will show the corrected amount.
